claim.assertion: For the registered GWOSC GW150914-v2 32-second 4096-Hz H1/L1 strain files, the declared 35–350 Hz zero-phase filter and 0.2-second event-window correlation recover an absolute intersite lag no larger than 10 ms.
claim.scope: Exact registered inputs and frozen workflow configuration only.
claim.strongest_warranted_conclusion: bounded computational repeatability of the registered processing path and satisfaction of one necessary intersite-lag invariant
explicit_exclusions: reproduction of the original search or detection significance
proof that the correlation has astrophysical origin
